tail:
A1/A2 is complete; A4 was not started.

- Coverage: 64/64 items, 55 proofs, 404 proof steps, 698 citation contracts, and 116 dependency targets read with no exceptions.
- Provenance: 12 exact-source, 40 semantic-source, two established-knowledge escalations, three novel/unsourced, and seven trivial constructions.
- Findings: seven ordinary A3 repair proposals and two owner-only dependency cleanups.
- Gates: manifest, content-policy shape, risk routing, and finite-smoke pass. Strict proof-contract has four expected errors corresponding exactly to pending findings.
